messages:
Evelyn: Thanks everyone for joining today's all-hands — this thread for follow-ups, clarifications, and owners. I'll drop the recording and slides and add items I missed.
MeetBot: Recording uploaded: https://redwood.slides/rec/1745009999 (transcript will be available in ~10m)
Priya: Quick Q — Dedicated GA timeframe? I thought we said late Q3 but want to be explicit for teams.
Evelyn: Target GA is Sept 15 (still provisional). We'll do staged rollouts: private beta -> partner beta -> GA. Docs with exact gates will be published next week.
Sam: Can someone put a 1-pager together on what Dedicated means for pricing, SLAs, and migration path? PMs need a brief for customer calls.
Evelyn: Yep. Sam, can you own the 1-pager?
Sam: I can own it. Will draft and post in #product by Friday (8/4).
Miguel: Ops question: will Dedicated include automatic node replacement and horizontal autoscaling out of the box, or is that a config for infra teams?
Evelyn: Autoscaling will be supported via our Dedicated control plane; automatic replacement for failed hosts is included in the SLA for GA. Miguel, can infra produce an ops checklist for onboarding customers?
Miguel: On it. I’ll compile a checklist + known limitations and share by Monday (8/7).
Jordan: Design request — need updated deployment diagrams showing Hosted / Dedicated / Private differences for the docs. Also want a short flow for failover behavior (fallback to hosted).
Priya: I’ll partner with Jordan on diagrams. We should add a small section on UX implications for latency and model selection.
Jordan: Cool. I'll sync with Priya and put an initial draft into the docs repo.
Kate: Are we still aiming for Private (VPC/on-prem) by EOY? Any blockers on compliance or KMS?
Evelyn: Private by EOY is still the goal, but KMS/HSM integrations are the gating factor. Research to scope required KMS partners and compliance gaps.
Sam: I’ll open a GH epic for Private deployment requirements and link compliance contacts. https://github.com/redwood/roadmap/issues/214
Priya: Also adding a note: Redwood Optimize examples should include sample prompts + perf baselines for Dedicated workloads. I’ll add a small eval set.
Evelyn: Action summary: Sam — 1-pager for PMs (due Fri 8/4). Jordan + Priya — deployment diagrams + UX note (draft Tue 8/8). Miguel — infra ops checklist (due Mon 8/7). Research — KMS scope (due Thu 8/17). Sam — GH epic for Private (linked). I’ll schedule a 30-min follow-up to walk owners through expectations next Tue 10am PT.
Sam: Ack — will post initial draft later today.
Priya: Ack, will drop diagrams and perf examples into the docs repo and ping here.
Miguel: Ack, I'll include known perf caveats + recommended telemetry keys.
Jordan: Adding templates for diagrams to the figma file and will mention versioning notes.
Kate: Thanks — can we also get a short line for sales on how to describe Dedicated differences vs Hosted? Even 2 bullets.
Sam: Will include 2 bullets in the 1-pager.
Evelyn: Thanks all. If you spot anything else in the recording that needs triage, drop it here. :raised_hands:
Priya: One more tiny ask — can we surface the new routing/fallback policy in the console docs? It's in the runtime PR but not yet user-facing.
Miguel: I'll add a note to the ops checklist to confirm config flags and console visibility.
Evelyn: Great. Closing thread for now — will reopen with the follow-up meeting invite.
Kate: :thumbsup:
Jordan: :+1:
